title: M8-04 — chronos-cli workspace member + engine events wiring + Saved-variant rework

commits.subject: docs(milestones): m8-04 chronos-cli + engine events + Saved-variant rework scoping (PROPOSED)
feat(services): m8-04 engine events wiring (pull_engine_events + shrink step 4)
feat(services+mcp+sandbox): m8-04 Saved-variant rework + events_count plumbing
feat(chronos-cli): workspace member + chronos test replay/run subcommands (m8-04 d3)
docs(sddk): m8-04 chronos-cli + engine events + Saved rework merge doc + apply-checkpoint

decisions: B2: direct services dispatch (no MCP wire)
B3: events pulled in shrink() not save()
B5: SessionStore path arg with XDG default
B6: in-memory engines map for replay

engine_events_wiring.new_method: pub async fn ChronosCounterexampleService::pull_engine_events(ctx: &CounterexampleContext, session_id: &str) -> Result<Vec<TraceEvent>, ServiceError>
engine_events_wiring.modify: shrink() step 4: now calls pull_engine_events(target.session_id) instead of vec![]
engine_events_wiring.missing_session_error: Err(ServiceError::SessionNotFound(session_id)) -- mirrors hypothesis_test::test line 92-95; no new variant

wire_envelope.mcp_serialize_counterexample_output: Saved emits {"bundle": <summary>, "events_count": <n>} (was {"saved": <summary>} stopgap). Shrunk propagates events_count into full.events_count (was hardcoded 0).
wire_envelope.sandbox_wrapper: CounterexampleShrinkOutputWire gains events_count + Option<CounterexampleBundleFullWire>; custom Deserialize impl reads top-level events_count first, falls back to full.events_count

saved_variant_rework.events_count_source: save() re-reads record via load_counterexample_bundle to surface events.len() -- one extra redb read per save. Acceptable; m9+ shortcut noted in commit msg.
tests_added_or_modified: ce1/ce5/ce6/ce7 smoke tests now assert events_count >= 1
ce7_shrink_response_uses_new_saved_envelope (NEW; uses typed wrapper because rpc_client is private)

test_replay.flow: load bundle -> rebuild QueryEngine from bundle.events -> reconstruct HypothesisInput from MinimisedPayload -> run ChronosHypothesisTestService::test -> print JSON ReplayReport

reconstruction.Constant(v): Invariant { scope: PropertyValue, comparison: None, constant: Some(v) }
reconstruction.Predicate(ExistencePredicateWire): Existence { predicate: Some(...) } via match-based ExistencePredicate conversion
reconstruction.CallPath {caller, callee, max_depth}: CallPath { caller, callee, max_depth as Option<usize> }

test_replay.disclosure: Reconstruction uses synthetic defaults for Invariant scope/comparison/property_target. A bundle minimised with non-default Invariant options cannot round-trip exactly; the round-trip is structurally faithful, not byte-for-byte. Storing the original target_hypothesis is m9+.

test_run.behaviour: Err(anyhow!("`chronos test run {program}` is not yet implemented (m9+ scope). Use `chronos test replay <bundle_id>` against an already-persisted bundle."))
test_run.rationale: Operators get a sane failure with milestone named, not a cryptic "command not found".

decisions.b1_no_clap: Hand-rolled parser in args.rs. Two subcommands don't justify clap.
decisions.b2_direct_services_dispatch: CLI does NOT open JSON-RPC to chronos-mcp; dispatches into chronos-services + chronos-store directly. Avoids round-tripping through a separate process for local-disk reads.
decisions.b5_xdg_default: --db defaults to $XDG_DATA_HOME/chronos/chronos.db, fallback $HOME/.local/share/chronos/chronos.db. Manual ~ expansion in args.rs (R-tilde-expansion).
decisions.b6_in_memory_engines_map: replay builds a synthetic QueryEngine::new(bundle.events) in a HashMap<String, QueryEngine> wrapped in tokio::sync::Mutex. Same shape MCP server uses for live sessions; lets us call the real hypothesis_test::test dispatcher without inventing a parallel execution path.

tests_run.t2_lib_unit_changed_crates: 232 chronos-services + 23 chronos-store + 18 chronos-cli = 273 tests, all green
tests_run.smoke_ce1_ce5_ce6_ce7: events_count >= 1; CE7 verifies new Saved envelope. All green in 39s (m8-04 execute 2).
tests_run.mcp_wrapper_smoke: saved {bundle, events_count} envelope verified via CounterexampleShrinkOutputWire custom Deserialize

disclosures.r_run_stub: `chronos test run` is a milestone-pinned stub returning Err with a clear m9+ message. Live-probe plumbing is m9+ scope.
disclosures.r_in_memory_engines: The temporary engines map for `chronos test replay` lives in the CLI's own HashMap; SessionStore::open is read-only from CLI's perspective.
disclosures.r_tilde_expansion: Only `~` and `~/...` are expanded by the manual arg parser. `~user/...` is intentionally NOT supported.
disclosures.r_hypothesis_reconstruction_fidelity: Replay reconstructs HypothesisInput from MinimisedPayload using synthetic defaults (scope=PropertyValue, no comparison, no property_target for Invariant). Structurally faithful, not byte-for-byte. Fixing this requires persisting the original target_hypothesis in the bundle (m9+).

notes: m8-04 was scoped doc-first (8589cce -> FF-merged to main as 34d0b81 before any code).
Three execute commits (engine events wiring, Saved-variant rework, chronos-cli) each landed and tested before the next.
Smoke subset for T4 was counterexample_shrink (the only sandbox test touching the changed wire envelope) -- picked per AGENTS.md §2 'How to pick the sandbox subset for T4-smoke'.

chronos-cli round-trip test (run_replay_round_trip_with_constant) drops the writer SessionStore before re-opening because redb holds an exclusive file lock; noted in the test docstring for future maintainers.
Workspace members list now includes chronos-cli. The chronos-sandbox entry remains last (intentional -- chronos-sandbox is the integration test crate, conventionally listed at the end).
